snippet.title: Unseen Beings - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/5183500/Unseen_Beings_Demo/

You owe a debt. They are sending you to retrieve a black briefcase in a secret auction house where they sell man-eating entities to the rich and powerful.

The auction house has had an incident and has become infested with invisible entities. You must use special goggles to see them, and avoid or fight them, while solving puzzles.

#horrorgame  #gametrailer   #indiehorror  #psx
